title: Prestige over merit: An adapted audit of LLM bias in peer review

bias_targets.methodology: An adapted résumé-style correspondence audit that evaluates identical scientific manuscripts using a multi-role LLM simulation, varying only the author's affiliated institution (elite vs. lower-prestige) to measure disparities in quality scores and rejection rates.

Counterfactual name substitution in prompts, evaluating identical scientific manuscripts while varying the author's synthetic name to signal male or female identity to observe differences in simulated peer review outcomes.

Counterfactual name substitution in prompts, evaluating identical scientific manuscripts while varying the author's synthetic name to signal Asian, Black, Hispanic, or White racial/ethnic identities to measure differences in LLM reviewer and editor evaluations.
